evidence.reason: Commit b66fad8d2c33821496609a4ab93e9d8e2b498683 adds unresolved-specifier refusal for dependency targets. A Service= value containing %j is therefore refused rather than silently passed through to CRQ_NAME_RE as an apparently non-CRQ name. The cited line range reflects old line carry; the current _expand_instance still handles only %i/%I, but the unresolved-specifier check prevents the asserted acceptance path.
